scope: existing CNR train/val and SUMO train/monitor only, common first six classes
continuity: dt=.25 seconds, maximum coordinate-derived speed 100 m/s, longest segment, earliest tie

source.note: Canonical columns only; speed stays in original CSV. Float32 XY and times verified unchanged.

encoding.scope: Full vehicle trajectory, original squeeze and mirror duplication, RGB GASF/GADF/MTF; newly trained CNN, not original classifier reproduction. Test neither encoded nor evaluated.
adaptations: Canonical time ordering verified by packer
local SUMO x/y used in original normalized coordinate slots, not claimed GPS
train-only coordinate and channel extrema frozen for deployment; clip out of bounds and count
keep previous vehicle split; no claim to original group classification accuracy

interpretation: Count matching preserves the CNR class proportions subject to availability. Duration matching minimizes total absolute log-span discrepancy without replacement within class and partition. It preserves count and the same selected CNR IDs, but does not guarantee duration overlap. Available snapshots retain every allowed original ID including short traces for separate positive controls. No original test trajectories receive records, features, images or diagnostic statistics.
exclusion_note: Participant-level exclusion IDs remain in the isolated run; only counts are published.
